title: DLMF 24.5 Recurrence Relations: In each of ( 24.5.9 ) and ( 24.5.10 ) the first identity implies the second one and vice-versa.
summary: DLMF 24.5 Recurrence Relations: In each of ( 24.5.9 ) and ( 24.5.10 ) the first identity implies the second one and vice-versa.
body: NIST DLMF section 24.5 (Recurrence Relations) says: "In each of ( 24.5.9 ) and ( 24.5.10 ) the first identity implies the second one and vice-versa." Equation 24.5.1 on the page has alt text "\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}{n\choose k}B_{k}\left(x\right)=nx^{n-1},". Equation 24.5.2 on the page has alt text "\sum_{k=0}^{n}{n\choose k}E_{k}\left(x\right)+E_{n}\left(x\right)=2x^{n},". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
